title: Future work on the record's tools
situation: Intent-based delegation was realized on 2026-10-15; its lead's outcome left follow-ups, and that work itself ran before the new ledger could record it.
decision: Remaining, each a task when taken up: (1) one decision may supersede several by name; (2) the ledger holds each story's stated rough cost, so an overrun against it shows; (3) agent runs launched outside a recorded dispatch are captured, so every run counts; (4) the lead's handover is named for what it holds, a story or a task, never one word for both; (5) an incomplete handover is matched to the form whose own parts are most present.
consequences: Priority is the operator's. The cost of realizing intent-based delegation is stated in its lead's outcome and pull request, not in the ledger.
